name: serverless-build-url-shortener
description: An isolated URL shortener with real analytics and full/claimable storage profiles

scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types claimable-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.claimable.jsonc --env-interface ClaimableEnv --include-runtime=false && tsc --noEmit
